title: President Trump on James Comey Indictment
shows: Trump on the White House South Lawn, listening to a reporter's shouted question about the Comey indictment before departure; guests and press behind a rope line, black SUV in background.

title: President Trump on James Comey Indictment
transcript: It's not a list, but I think there'll be others. I mean, they're corrupt.
shows: Trump on the White House South Lawn answering a reporter's question about who is 'next on the list' after Comey.

title: President Trump on James Comey Indictment
transcript: I hope there are others because you can't let this happen to a country.
shows: Trump on the White House South Lawn, mid-answer, gesturing while talking to reporters.

title: President Trump on James Comey Indictment
transcript: He's a dirty cop. He's always been a dirty cop. Everybody knew it.
shows: Trump on the White House South Lawn, animated, calling Comey a 'dirty cop' in response to a reporter asking if the case is about justice or revenge.

title: Comey responds to indictment saying 'I'm innocent'
transcript: And I'm innocent. So, let's have a trial.
shows: James Comey's own Instagram video statement, replayed by NBC News, head-and-shoulders against a plain background, closing his response to the indictment.
